objective.name: positive-closure-of-current-source-derived-route
objective.meaning: Maximize probability of obtaining the scoped certificate in this finite attempt portfolio, then minimize expected total effort including downstream work.
not_established: negative resolution of every possible source-derived lift

observed_attempts.note: Coherence alone admits arbitrary schedule semantics; the source-derived predicate remains unspecified. Replan without unlocking source-contract-typed.

assumptions: Forecast only: interfaces added on hypothetical certified branches are not facts in the scientific net.
One bounded attempt per stage; prove/reject alternatives share a stage ticket. Failure ends this portfolio, not the mathematical conjecture. Replanning and retries require new estimates.

A source audit success supplies a typed contract, not a lift. The subsequent source-lift certificate is conditional on the declared full analytic interface; the final decoder requires that interface to be discharged.
Completion norm and remaining analytics are separate stages: the latter includes pi half-turn endpoints, continuity, generator compatibility, and fresh closure of the transfer theorem.

Branch probabilities are subjective conditional-on-arrival estimates. We assume they do not change with the order of successful prerequisite-independent stages. This is not a calibrated joint scientific posterior.
No information objective is substituted for closure success. Rejection can be scientifically useful without contributing to positive closure of this fixed route.
The audit may expose a different contract, invalidating downstream estimates. Its modeled success means it yields the intended planning contract; otherwise stop and replan.
Costs remain work-cycle budgets, not wall time; a certificate only counts if its required verification succeeds.

stages.basis: One-cycle diagnostic; central 0.7 chance of producing a usable typed contract. Newly proposed assumption, not a measured success rate.
stages.protocol: Inventory external choices, type the source lift and its whole-section interface, and check the pointwise-selection obstruction. Do not count mere endpoint matching as success.
Construct or refute the audited source contract. A construction may expose the full analytic interface as a premise; final closure cannot leave it assumed.
Prove or refute ScheduledNormBound for the actual operational representatives; fresh certificate verification required.

stages.basis: Standard analytic construction suggests truth; implementing pi, continuity, generator laws and fresh closure is substantial unmeasured work.
stages.protocol: Discharge pi half-turn laws, continuity, generator compatibility and fresh transfer closure; or certify failure of this specified completion construction.
Check the unitary replacement against the audited whole-section contract, retaining reconstruction and schedule coherence. No external analytic assumptions may remain.

sensitivity.method: Each prior, conditional certificate likelihood, and cost varied individually to its low/high estimate, with downstream planning recomputed; plus all-low and all-high scenarios.
sensitivity.limitation: Finite stress tests, not proof of robustness over the full parameter box.
